purpose: Prove a leakage-safe 2022-2025 availability-state contract for the exact regular-season game universe consumed by LevLine before V09B may execute.

amendment_record.reason: The first contract draft carried stale 2022-2024 nflverse injury digests copied from an earlier source snapshot. The immediately subsequent v1 source-only CI pass fetched the exact current release bytes and exposed the mismatch before any strict v2 official-page, identity, practice-agreement, chronology, or model metrics were executed. The source pins are corrected here to those observed bytes; no threshold, state definition, model universe, or acceptance criterion changes.

Raw NFL.com HTML can contain delivery-layer boilerplate unrelated to the injury-report state. Freeze the independent-source digest over the parsed semantic row contract instead, while retaining and content-addressing every raw HTML page separately. This makes the pin sensitive to player/team/week/practice/game-status evidence but not irrelevant dynamic page markup.

The first strict-v2 live attempt halted while validating the nflverse players identity asset, before any season official-page, identity, practice-agreement, chronology, or qualification metrics ran. The nflverse players release had been republished on 2026-09-12. Pin the exact current release asset and digest reported by the GitHub release API; identity remains alias-only and a candidate GSIS must still exist in the same historical season/week/team injury rows.

scope_basis.preexisting_model_invariant: src/nfl_forecast/features.py filters both PBP and schedule scaffolds to regular season before matchup features and home_win are built.
scope_basis.rationale: This contract does not reclassify or repair the terminal all-22-week V4 source result. It separately qualifies only the pre-existing model evaluation universe; V09B cannot score postseason games because the model feature builder excludes them before evaluation.

identity_source.policy: Exact normalized aliases only; candidate GSIS must already exist in the same season/week/team injury rows. No fuzzy matching, status, injury, position, current team, snaps, participation, game outcome, or 2026 information may choose identity.

independent_crosscheck.semantic_hash_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 CSV with LF line endings, no index, sorted by semantic_hash_columns, after complete semantic duplicate collapse and preregistered model-universe exception removal.
independent_crosscheck.raw_page_policy: Retain every week 1-18 HTML response and its individual SHA-256 in the audit artifact; raw page bytes are evidence but are not the frozen semantic state digest.
independent_crosscheck.hash_policy: Qualification is audit-only until the semantic regular-season official-source bundle SHA-256 is pinned for every season after a successful strict collection pass.

schedule_source.filter: season in 2022-2025 and game_type == REG, with preregistered model-universe exceptions excluded from the model-eligible linkage subset
schedule_source.hash_policy: Hash UTF-8 CSV with LF line endings, no index, sorted by season/week/game_id, over exactly hash_columns after the model-eligible filter.
schedule_source.pin_policy: Qualification is audit-only until the observed derived subset hash from a successful strict collection pass is pinned.

chronology.authority: NFL Personnel (Injury) Report Policy filing day
chronology.date_modified_policy: For 2022-2024, nflverse date_modified is a source-integrity diagnostic only and never replaces official filing-day chronology.

model_universe_exceptions.reason: NFL-cancelled Bills at Bengals game; no completed game enters the LevLine historical outcome/evaluation frame.

missingness_semantics.injury_row_present: player listed on weekly injury report
missingness_semantics.injury_row_absent: not injury-listed in this source; never impute active or healthy from absence alone
missingness_semantics.schedule_unmatched: blocked unless the exact season/week/team is a preregistered model-universe exception
